verdict.rationale: vLLM's PagedAttention, KV-cache management, and GPU-memory-utilization/parallelism controls (tensor/pipeline/data/expert/context parallelism) give power-users levers to control memory allocation across concurrent model instances, but the evidence is generic doc bullet points rather than a concrete guide on multi-instance memory partitioning. missing for 10: explicit documentation or benchmarks on configuring memory allocation across multiple concurrent model instances (e.g. gpu_memory_utilization flags per instance, multi-model serving memory isolation), and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific control.
